featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointing Experience with Brijwasi Sweets – Poor Quality & Unresponsive Service
Rating: ⭐️ 1/5

I’ve been a regular customer of Brijwasi Sweets, ordering from different outlets over time. However, trying this particular outlet was a huge mistake that I genuinely regret.

I had ordered Kesar Vati, Malai Chamcham, and Kesar Kaju Katli. Sadly, both the Kesar Vati and Malai Chamcham were stale, dry, and sour—a clear sign that they were not fresh. The texture was hard, completely opposite of how fresh sweets should be. It was genuinely disappointing and quite off-putting.

To make matters worse, the Kesar Kaju Katli had a bad odor. While the taste was just about okay, the smell was concerning. After consuming just a small portion, we started feeling uneasy in the stomach. Thankfully, we stopped right there or the outcome could’ve been worse.

What added to the frustration was the apathetic attitude of the outlet. When I contacted them regarding the issue, they flatly denied any fault and refused to acknowledge the poor quality. Their only response was to raise the issue with Zomato, adding that they don’t refund for quality concerns—which is simply unacceptable.

If you’re looking to get embarrassed in front of guests or risk food-related illness, then by all means, order from this outlet. Otherwise, avoid it entirely. This experience has left a sour taste—literally and figuratively—and I certainly won’t be ordering from this outlet again.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

We have spoken to the outlet team, and they maintain that the products sent were fresh and as per standard. However, we are investigating this matter thoroughly, including your complaint about the response received.

Brijwasi Sweets, Chandivali

featured_reviews.name: Pavithran Iyer Sridharan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve ordered from Humble Flavors so many times now, for myself and for friends and family, and I can honestly say I’m totally hooked!

The laddoos are absolutely delightful, and the best part, they’re made in such a healthy way!! No preservatives, and thoughtfully prepared so even those who prefer no sugar or ghee can enjoy them guilt-free. I was amazed at the ingredients they use... some of them I would never have imagined could turn into such yummy sweets!

My personal favorites are the Besan and Sattu laddoos. The Millet Medley is fantastic too, perfect for when you want something filling and tasty. I often carry them on long flights as a quick snack, and they’re a total lifesaver!

Among my friends, the Mocha Magic and Cocoa flavors are big hits. Every single person I’ve gifted these to has loved them, which makes them my go-to present now.

On top of that, the ordering experience is super smooth. They’re very responsive and helpful on WhatsApp, and they’ve even accommodated my last-minute requests several times. Since I live in Mumbai, I really appreciate how flexible they are with pickup timings too.

Delicious, healthy, thoughtful, and reliable! highly recommend!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Pavithran, Thank you so much for this incredibly kind and detailed review! 

This would easily be the longest review I have ever received! Reading this truly made my day.

It means the absolute world to me that you trust Humble Flavors enough to not only treat yourself, but also to share my laddoos with your friends and family. Knowing that they have become your "go-to" present is the highest compliment a home chef could ever ask for!

It brings a huge smile to my face to picture my Millet Medley laddoos traveling with you as a lifesaver snack on long flights! 

Being based right here in Mumbai allows me to personally connect with wonderful customers like you. I can’t wait to whip up your next batch!

Warmly,
Richa

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently ordered sattu, besan, and yellow dal laddus from Humble flavors, and I am absolutely blown away! All of them were so awesome, so fresh and not overly sweet. You can really taste the quality of ingredients. A special shoutout to the owner for being so accommodative to get them on time. It’s hard to find such authentic taste and great customer service. Highly recommended!
